one_line: A seasoned Malabar pepper trader moving cargo between hill producers and Indian Ocean routes in early 15th–16th century Calicut.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, lean but sturdy build, average height.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm brown complexion, neatly trimmed black beard and moustache, straight nose, sharp observant eyes, a small healed cut near the left eyebrow; default expression calm, calculating, slightly welcoming with a hint of shrewd focus.
appearance.hair: Straight, shoulder‑length black hair, oiled and combed back from the forehead, partly covered by a simple dark indigo cloth turban wrapped low and snug around the head, with the tail tucked at the nape of the neck.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee‑length off‑white cotton angarkha‑style long tunic with side ties, the neckline modestly closed, over a deep brown cotton dhoti wrapped low but securely and falling to the ankles, pleats in front; a wide, slightly faded brick‑red cotton waist sash is tied firmly around his midsection with the knot over the left hip; over one shoulder is a dark indigo lightweight cotton shawl used as a practical wrap in the bazaar; simple leather sandals on his feet; accessories include a thin gold chain at the neck, a pair of small gold hoop earrings, several plain copper and brass bangles on his right wrist, and a cloth pouch tied to his waist sash, appropriate to a prosperous but working merchant in Malabar.
appearance.signature: A medium‑sized, tightly woven palm‑leaf basket filled with dried black peppercorns, carried in his left hand, with a wooden tally stick and a small cloth ledger roll tucked visibly into the basket’s rim.

ref_desc: Calicut Pepper Merchant has a warm brown oval face with short beard, shoulder‑length black hair under a dark indigo turban, off‑white angarkha, deep brown dhoti, brick‑red sash, palm‑leaf pepper basket with tally stick, and gold accents in a warm brown‑and‑indigo palette.
sheet_prompt: Full‑body anime‑style character of the Calicut Pepper Merchant: a lean, late‑30s Malabar trader with a warm brown oval face, sharp eyes, a neat short black beard and moustache, and straight shoulder‑length black hair partly covered by a snug dark indigo cloth turban. He wears a knee‑length off‑white cotton angarkha‑style tunic over a deep brown ankle‑length dhoti, secured with a wide brick‑red waist sash knotted over his left hip, and a dark indigo shawl draped from one shoulder; simple leather sandals complete his modest, practical bazaar look. Show a thin gold chain, small gold hoop earrings, copper and brass bangles on his right wrist, and a cloth pouch at his waist. In his left hand he carries a tightly woven palm‑leaf basket filled with dried black peppercorns, with a wooden tally stick and rolled cloth ledger tucked into the basket’s rim. Use off‑white, deep brown, brick red, dark indigo, and warm gold as the dominant colours, presented in a clean, consistent model sheet view with front‑facing, three‑quarter, and back poses emphasizing the fixed face, hair, costume, and pepper basket prop.
